body:
S195-01: bundled libSDL2/libSDL2_ttf + patchelf RPATH so pitviper runs standalone on a fresh Linux machine (no dependency resolution, matching marcosnils/bin's raw-binary install model). Real GitHub Actions run confirmed green (commit c907d21), real non-prerelease v0.4.0 release created with the bundled tarball.

⚓ ☃
title: SDL2 bundling for bin-installable Linux distribution — CI-verified
